claim: The rename changes the spelling of `IsCompl.projection` in the name from `isCompl_projection` to `isComplProjection`, so the PR leaves `coe_starProjection_eq_isComplProjection` as the only declaration in the library with that spelling. The three existing lemmas about the same definition still use `isCompl_projection`: `IsIdempotentElem.eq_isCompl_projection` and `isIdempotentElem_iff_eq_isCompl_projection_range_ker` (LinearAlgebra/Projection.lean:604, 612) and `linearProjOfIsCompl_isCompl_projection` (LinearAlgebra/Projection.lean:224). Only part of the API follows the new convention.
requested_change: Finish the convention in this PR. Rename `IsIdempotentElem.eq_isCompl_projection` to `IsIdempotentElem.eq_isComplProjection`, `isIdempotentElem_iff_eq_isCompl_projection_range_ker` to `isIdempotentElem_iff_eq_isComplProjection_range_ker` and `linearProjOfIsCompl_isCompl_projection` to `linearProjOfIsCompl_isComplProjection`, each with a `@[deprecated (since := "2025-12-26")] alias` under its old name. Update the uses in LinearAlgebra/Projection.lean (lines 229, 235, 614) and InnerProductSpace/Symmetric.lean:299. If the camelCase spelling is not intended, keep the old one instead and name the lemma `coe_starProjection_eq_isCompl_projection`.
evidence: I searched the PR tree for `isCompl_projection|isComplProjection` with content_search. `isComplProjection` appears only in this PR's lemma, its alias and its two uses in Positive.lean. `isCompl_projection` appears in three base declarations, `IsIdempotentElem.eq_isCompl_projection`, `isIdempotentElem_iff_eq_isCompl_projection_range_ker` and `linearProjOfIsCompl_isCompl_projection`, and in a use at Symmetric.lean:299. declaration_search places the definition at `Submodule.IsCompl.projection` (LinearAlgebra/Projection.lean:154). zulip_search found the community convention the new spelling follows: Yaël Dillies (maintainer) on 2025-04-20, 'a definition whose name is ambiguous without its namespace should have its namespace prepended back in lowerCamelCase when used outside its namespace' (Task 24, e.g. `continuous_subtypeVal`). A bare `projection` is ambiguous, so `isComplProjection` is the right spelling, and the siblings are the outliers once this PR lands. naming_norm on the new name only measured the leading prefix (`coe_` vs `toLinearMap_`, verdict emerging), not this middle component.
